value.rationale: The first non-Gaussian Hermite window is a natural phase-space concentration model. The theorem classifies the exact norm and its maximizing signal for every disk area, identifies the unique threshold of a three-dimensional top eigenspace, and gives the entire infinite adjacency-crossing staircase. These are structural spectral facts, not an arbitrary slice or numerical cutoff.
